dct_creator_sm: Prince Edward Island Government Open Data Portal.
dct_description_sm:
Reports the total number of Government of Prince Edward Island employees as of the last pay period processed in December of each year.

Classified employees include permanent, probationary and provisional employees.

Unclassified employees include casual, temporary, contract and student employees. Unclassified employees reported include the total number of employees who received pay for the pay period ending Dec 21, 2024.
